'''Zyn''' was a corpulent [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Inquisitor]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|This is not an idle diversion, acolyte. A short while ago, there was what we call an "unauthorized murder" here in the academy. A rivalry among apprentices resulted in death.|Zyn, to the [[Sith Inquisitor]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
During the Cold War, Zyn learned of a murder inside the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy's]] walls, and captured and tortured a witness named [[Alif]] for more information about the incident. [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Harkun]] sent a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] to Zyn as part of the apprentice's trials, and Zyn permitted the acolyte to finish the questioning and reveal the killer's name.<ref name="TOR" />
